question: Does ENERGY-45's contradiction-gated factor replacement retain strong old-context accuracy and generalize across three new causal families and disjoint seeds, better than fully trained conventional, equal-information hybrid and no-change controls?
prior: ENERGY-45 archived at f2556ffca7dfefc0c026240b1694edbf34fdc2ec; 7/9 gates, aggregate candidate cold MSE .11163 but failures old relative accuracy and seed stability. No reuse of ENERGY-45 primary seeds or metric threshold tuning.

dataset.generator: independent SHA256-seeded synthetic additive factor consequence model. Planted 5 signed factors, 3 shared plus 1 old-only and 1 new-only; 1/4 worlds unchanged, only nuisance cues shift.
dataset.candidate_known_grammar: 364 signed unary/two-bit/three-bit parity and two-bit conjunction features

candidate.name: replay_gated
candidate.old_context: OMP4 trained on 96 old outcomes and *frozen* for old predictions
candidate.new_context: Enumerate candidate delete-one/add-one supports, shortlisted by first 72 new training residual correlations, 24 new TRAIN consequences used for validation. Trigger if replacement lowers validation MSE by at least .12. Refit selected 4 supports on all 96 new witness outcomes; otherwise refit original 4 supports using all 96 new witnesses. Old model never changed.
candidate.capacity: Four old and four new selected supports; known fixed grammar, no free-form operator discovery.

negative_controls: no_repair (frozen old support without any new adaptation)
shuffled_gate (new training labels shuffled before gate)
unconditional_replay (same feature replacement with no gate)

frozen_gates.cold_vs_best_10pct: Candidate mean cold held MSE <=0.90 × minimum conventional aggregate cold MSE across seven fully trained matched controls.
frozen_gates.cold_vs_matched_hybrid_5pct: Candidate cold held MSE <=0.95 × conventional validation-selected hybrid old/new model cold MSE.
frozen_gates.old_vs_best_1pct: Candidate old held MSE <=1.01 × minimum conventional aggregate old MSE among the seven controls.
frozen_gates.old_replay_retention_1pct: Candidate old held MSE <=1.01 × unchanged no_repair old context model; no post-new training overwrite.
frozen_gates.changed_correct_support_70pct: In 27 changed worlds, at least 70% of gate triggers delete exact obsolete planted support and install exact new planted support.
frozen_gates.nochange_false_edit_at_most_10pct: On nine unchanged worlds, gate correctly declines replacement >=90%.
frozen_gates.sham_new_20pct: Candidate new held MSE <=0.80 × shuffled-new-label negative control new held MSE.
frozen_gates.seed_wins_2of3: Candidate mean cold MSE strictly below strongest conventional mean cold MSE separately in at least two of three independent seeds.
frozen_gates.time_at_most_3x_memory: Candidate measured local fit+old/new/cold inference wall seconds <=3 × full conventional structural-memory OMP7 measured total on the same 36 worlds.

decision.development_go: All nine gates PASS and source-free independent all-arm refit audit PASS. Still external synthetic development only, not scientific native qualification.
decision.development_no_go: Any one frozen gate FAIL with source/controls/audit intact. No tuning consumed seeds.
decision.invalid: Any source/prereg/custody mismatch, primary evaluated before freeze, train/held label leak, unequal inputs, missing controls, broken exact scorer or independent audit.
decision.mixed: Report ALL gates and disjoint per-seed and per-family outcomes; do not choose favorable families post hoc.

environment.measurement: Python fit+prediction elapsed, not whole-host Joules or CI cost

preprimary_smoke.development_notes: First development smoke identified a catastrophically weak cumulative old-memory head; before source freeze it was replaced by the frozen OMP4 old head. Second development smoke verified 6/9 eligible gates; redundant duplicate arm removed and final smoke audited. No primary seed examined.

note: Source+auditor code committed before this preregistration at 78dffbfecfa7616822514cf1e5414a1ae467de67. Primary seeds 8909/8923/8933 have not been scored. Qualifying against no-change and strong conventional controls is mandatory.
